entry.title: Have you got the time, Ceph?

link.title: Have you got the time, Ceph?

entry.summary: Have you got the time, Ceph? Ceph’s monitors refuse to work with a clock more than 0.05 s off (mon_clock_drift_allowed), and my own health check on the appliance flags a node past 10 s. So a node that is two minutes off is a node out of the cluster.
